fields.why: Table 2 stratifies adult coverage by functional disability ('serious difficulty seeing, hearing, walking...'), a demographic stratifier rather than a clinical condition, so a stratifier entry is defensible; but the text never frames it as social position or access, which the brief requires, so omitting it is also defensible. It does not change the level.

brief_issues: Only label A's full record was in the packet; B rated from its values alone. The brief should say whether an unframed functional-disability row in a demographic table counts as the disability SPD (stratifier).
